title: Retire public fleet-operating content from quest-cli (OPAG-70)
description:
Fleet-wide campaign OPAG-70, user ruling relayed by opum-agent: fleet-internal content must not be public. quest-cli was one of three public repos carrying it (the inline opum:fleet-operating block, the repository-profile block, and tracked hook-identity credentials in .claude/settings.json).

Four steps, all reversible, completed:
1. Retired the operating-block-digest required check from main's ruleset first (gh api), then removed the operating-block job from prepublication-qualification.yml -- ordering matters, since removing the block first while the check stayed required would make dev->main permanently unpushable.
2. Replaced the inline opum:fleet-operating block with @~/.claude/opum-fleet-operating.md, a canonical home-directory import outside every repository -- chosen over gitignoring CLAUDE.md because a background session under .claude/worktrees/ would silently lose a worktree-local CLAUDE.local.md.
3. Stripped CLAUDE.md to contributor-relevant guidance: removed Approval routing, Cross-repo dependencies (verified), Consolidated authority routing, Sibling sessions, and the opum:repo-profile block (all session-topology/authority-model content naming peer sessions). 355 lines -> 70.
4. Moved OPUM_HOOK_ACTOR/OPUM_HOOK_ACCOUNTABLE_HUMAN out of tracked .claude/settings.json into gitignored .claude/settings.local.json; git rm --cached + physically removed the tracked file once duplicated and verified.

Deliberately not done: purging this content from git history. That is the campaign's fifth step, in the operating block's dangerous set, reserved for this session's own user's direct authority -- opum-agent explicitly did not instruct it and said they would raise it separately.

Filed retroactively -- branched and committed (as security/OPAG-70-retire-public-fleet-content) before creating this task, then caught that the commit had accidentally landed directly on local dev rather than a branch, moved it to a proper branch before pushing, and am now filing the task to match this repo's own branch-needs-a-task-id convention.

acceptanceCriteria.text: operating block digest is no longer a required status check on main, and the job is removed from CI, verified via gh api against the exact ruleset (not assumed)

CLAUDE.md imports the canonical @~/.claude/opum-fleet-operating.md instead of carrying the inline block, and the fleet-operating block digest is confirmed unchanged before/after the edit since it sits outside the guarded region

CLAUDE.md is stripped to contributor-relevant guidance only -- Approval routing, Cross-repo dependencies (verified), Consolidated authority routing, Sibling sessions, and the repository-profile block are removed, verified under 200 lines

Hook-identity env vars no longer live in a tracked file; a hook-shaped write using them was actually run and verified landed via quest task view after the move, not assumed from the hook silently swallowing failure

implementationNotes: PR #357: gh api confirmed main's required_status_checks is now [source-gates] only (post-change, gh api repos/opum-ai/quest-cli/rules/branches/main). CLAUDE.md digest recomputed before (4cbdcba163ba318f) and after (4cbdcba163ba318f) -- edit at lines 105-106/59-64 sits outside the guarded 140-315 range, confirmed via line-number check before editing. CLAUDE.md now 70 lines (was 355), confirmed via wc -l. Hook verification: read flush-state.sh source directly (env-var only, no settings-file dependency), then ran quest task edit --add-note --actor "$OPUM_HOOK_ACTOR" --accountable-human "$OPUM_HOOK_ACCOUNTABLE_HUMAN" against QCLI-262 after physically deleting .claude/settings.json, then confirmed via quest task view that the note actually landed.
finalSummary: OPAG-70's four steps landed via PR #357 (squash-merged, dev at a627569): main's required-checks ruleset retired the digest gate first (verified via gh api against the exact rule, not assumed), the operating-block job removed from CI, CLAUDE.md now imports @~/.claude/opum-fleet-operating.md with the digest confirmed unchanged (4cbdcba163ba318f before/after), CLAUDE.md stripped from 355 to 70 lines, and hook-identity env vars moved to gitignored settings.local.json with a live hook-shaped write verified to actually land post-move. History purge deliberately not attempted -- reserved for the user's own direct authority, not instructed. One process note: caught and corrected a direct commit to local dev before it reached origin.
